note: The CDP Addresses TLV count is read from the input; this candidate sets it to 2 while only providing one encoded address entry.
The first address entry's input-controlled address length is read as 4 and accounted for before the address bytes are consumed.

The parser advances past the 4 address bytes but, in this vulnerable revision, does not subtract address_len from addresses_len, so the remaining-length accounting falsely reports bytes still available.
After parsing the first entry, pos is restored to the end of the only supplied address entry while the loop count still requires another iteration.
On the second advertised address, pos is already at the end of the frame; PEEK_UINT8 reads the next address protocol length byte from beyond the candidate buffer.
